CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  AGENDA
  ENVIRONMENTAL COMMITTEE
  MARCH 11, 2021
  MISSION STATEMENT
  The City of Alhambra is dedicated to responsive, creative leadership and quality
  services, ensuring desirable neighborhoods and a supportive business
  environment, while being sensitive to the diversity of our community.

  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE
Consistent with Executive Orders No. N-29-20 and No. N-35-20 from the Executive Department of the State
of California and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health Safer At Home Order, the
Alhambra Environmental Committee meeting will not be physically open to the public, although the
public may participate by video conference or teleconference and some of the Committee Members
may choose to participate via video conference or teleconference.

To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency and
public access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Webinar as follows:
Zoom Webinar direct link:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88234356949?pwd=L3oyb1YreTdzMzlHSHNDMFB3bEcydz09
Meeting ID: 882 3435 6949, Passcode: 985710
Or by telephone by dialing 888-475-4499 (Toll Free) or 833-548-0276 (Toll Free) or 833-548-0282 (Toll
Free) or 877-853-5257 (Toll Free) or 1-669-900-9128 or 1-346-248-7799 or 1-253-215-8782 or 1-646-558-
8656 or 1-301-715-8592 or 1-312-626-6799 and entering Meeting ID: 882 3435 6949and Passcode:
985710. Please Note: All members of the public calling or logging into the meeting will be muted so that
the meeting can proceed.
For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please email Deputy Director David Dolphin at
ddolphin@cityofalhambra.org 5:00 p.m. prior to the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on
and the phone number you will use when calling or the name you will use when logging into the
meeting. You should then call or log into the meeting at least 10 minutes prior to its start time. Staff will
unmute you and announce you when it is your time to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless
that time is adjusted. If you do not have access to a computer please call 626-300-1571 to request public
comment.
As an alternative to speaking during the meeting, you can email your comments to the David Dolphin
ddolphin@cityofalhambra.org by no later than 5:00 p.m. on March 11, 2021 to ensure that the City has
time to print the emails prior to the beginning of the meeting. Comments will then be read into the record by
the City Clerk, with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per individual comment, subject to the Mayor’s
discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 p.m. but before the conclusion of the meeting based upon its
time stamp, the comment will still be included as a part of the record of the meeting but will not be read into
the record.
Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should
email or call the Public Works Department at ddolphin@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 300-1571 who will use
their best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide as much accessibility as possible while
also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of teleconference and video conference meetings,
all participants are encouraged to email their comments prior to the beginning of the meeting.

   CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  ALHAMBRA ENVIRONMENTAL COMMITTEE
  City Hall, 111 South First Street
  MARCH 11, 2021
  6:00 p.m.

  I.  ROLL CALL
  John Vuong, Kim Luu, Michael Daninger, Katie Chan

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

  III.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS
  Each year the committee is appointed by the City Council. At this time, it is appropriate to conduct
  an election to determine which members will chair the meeting as president and in the event the
  chair cannot attend the meeting, determine which member will step in as Vice President to conduct
  the meeting.
  Recommended Action: That the Committee elect a new president and vice president to chair the
  meeting.

  IV.  MEASURE W OVERVIEW
  Deputy Director David Dolphin will give an update on Measure W, the Safe Clean Water Program
  and discuss the City’s proposal for a Green Street Demonstration Project on Main St. at Fremont
  Ave.
  Recommended Action: Information only. No action required.

  V.  PUBLIC COMMENTS
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments are welcome, but
  must pertain to the business of the Alhambra Environmental Committee. Please limit all oral
  communication to five (5) minutes. Speakers must fill out a blue speaker’s card, prior to the meeting
  and submit it to the Committee Secretary. Comments must pertain to the business of the
  Environmental Committee. Please limit all oral communications to five (5) minutes.

  VI.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee members of any item not specified on the agenda. Items must
  pertain to the business of the Alhambra Environmental Committee.

  VII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Adjournment to the next regular meeting on Thursday, May 13, 2021 at 6:00 p.m.

  Copies of staff reports or other written documentation, if any, relating to each item of business
  described above are on file in the Alhambra City Hall, Public Works Department, 111 S. First
  Street, Alhambra California 91801 and are available for public inspection upon request during
  regular business hours of 7:00am to 5:30pm, Monday through Thursday.

  Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the
  meeting described herein, he or she may contact Martin Ray, Director of Public Works & Utilities,
  either in person at the Public Works Department at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street, or
  by calling via telephone at (626) 570-5067 during regular business hours.
